observation.command: echo "=== dev server procs ==="; ps aux | grep -E "[n]x [a-z]+:serve|[n]x run" | head -5; echo "=== dev ports on host ==="; (ss -tln 2>/dev/null | grep -E "34237|35581|38377") || echo "none of 34237/35581/38377 listening"; echo "=== proxy container host.docker.internal ==="; docker exec urbo-proxy getent hosts host.docker.internal 2>&1 | head -2; docker exec urbo-proxy wget -qO- --timeout=5 http://host.docker.internal:35581/ 2>&1 | head -c 120; echo
